notes.title: Quick Update!
notes.content:
We've just rolled out a new update with some fine-tuning and fresh additions to make the gameplay even better! Here’s what’s new:
[list]
[*] Fixed bottle throwing for player
[*] Added healing animation: Now you can visibly see player healing himself after getting caught
[/list]
Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to improve and expand the game. Your feedback helps us keep refining and thank you for being part of this journey!

notes.title: Happy Halloween!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce a major update for Psycho! This release comes with enhanced visuals, improved gameplay mechanics, and a more immersive horror experience. We're putting everything we have into making Psycho a standout experience, and we’re listening closely to your feedback to make it the best it can be.

[b][h2]Update List:[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Killer getting stuck
[*] Fixed Killer block the road for too long
[*] Improve Killer attacks
[*] Improved throwing bottles for Player
[*] Improved sliding for Player
[*] Added different attacks for Killer
[*] Added 3D model for player
[*] Added Fightback System: When the Killer catches player, press the mouse button to punch back and escape!
[/list]

Like many great games (Cyberpunk fans, we see you), Psycho is evolving, and while you may still encounter some bugs, rest assured that we’re committed to refining and perfecting it. We're already working on fixes to address these, and future updates will bring even more polish to the game. Thank you for being part of this journey and stay tuned for even more updates.

notes.title: New Update Released: Small Fixes, Big Impact!
notes.content:
Today, we’ve rolled out a new update with some important fixes to enhance your experience in Psycho. While we’re taking small steps, each one brings us closer to delivering an even more immersive and terrifying game. October is just getting started, and we have plenty of surprises in store for you this month. Stay tuned!

[b] Fixes List: [/b]
[list]
    [*]Inspecting :No more pressing E to make mouse cursor appears. similar to Resident Evil 8 inspecting but without moving the objects only rotating.
    [*]Look through ground: Camera stopped going through the ground when killer throw you.
    [*]Head Bobbing: Enhance head bobbing while running and walking.
    [*]Fixed minor bugs related to item pickup and inventory. 
[/list]

notes.title: First Update Released: Halloween Month of Fear Begins!
notes.content: We're kicking off October, the month of fear, with our very first update! This update enhances the game’s graphics to immerse you even deeper into the horror experience. But that's just the beginning. Throughout the month, expect multiple updates packed with chilling surprises and improvements, all leading up to Halloween. Stay tuned for more fear-inducing features!
